Totally get it—picking can feel like standing in front of a massive buffet. Here are a few ways to narrow it down:

Browse box options and promos: Head to our site and use Choose Your Plan to see current deals and box types.
Check product details: When you click on any item, you’ll see ingredients, nutrition, and sourcing so you can match your tastes or dietary needs.
Look at specialty items: We’ve got 100+ options, from thick-cut steaks to gluten-free chicken nuggets, all free of 200+ banned ingredients.
Get cooking inspo: Our Recipes and Just Cook blog pages have tons of recipes and tips so you can pick cuts that fit how you like to cook.
Prefer one-time or gifts? You can order one-time gift boxes or eGift Cards instead of (or before) starting a subscription.
Want to try us between boxes or without a subscription? You can also find select ButcherBox cuts in many Target stores nationwide and some Costcos in the Pacific Northwest.

So, think about how you like to cook (quick weeknights vs. weekend projects) and whether you want ongoing deliveries or a one-time box, then use the plan chooser and product details to build the best fit for you.

If you’re looking for everyday use, strong quality, and good value, here’s how we stack up:

Both Signature and Essentials boxes include high‑quality, humanely raised meat and seafood, free from antibiotics and added hormones.
For best value for money on everyday staples, the Essentials Plan is likely your sweet spot: it’s $159 for six cuts and up to ~21 lbs of core items like ground beef, chicken breasts, and pork chops.
If you also want access to fancier cuts (ribeye, filet mignon, scallops) while still getting staples, the Signature Plan starts at $179 and lets you choose from both 50+ core cuts and 30+ specialty cuts.
Either way, as a subscriber you also get:
Free shipping
Access to member deals for extra savings and bonus meat
Flexible account management (change box size, cuts, and frequency before your bill date)
Extras like recipes and loyalty rewards

So, based only on value-for-money everyday use, I’d point you to the Essentials box, unless you know you’ll regularly want those premium steakhouse-style cuts, in which case Signature is worth the small bump in price.
